title: Trump, Rubio and Hegseth are fumbling Ukraine – Europe needs to stop making the same mistake
lede: For now, Ukrainians are Europe’s human shields. If their defence breaks, a triumphant, battle-hardened Russia will seek its next victim, while the US may decide to back a winner not a loser. For now, Europe’s problem is only a lack of will-power: a nice problem to have.
